summary: Visual evidence is insufficient for this high-risk production claim. Local ignored artifacts show raw/centerline panels and limited four-plane tracking examples, but no identical-framing comparison spanning raw images, both probability heads, filled masks, centerlines, instance boundaries, tracks, and final overlays. The tracking examples are deliberately restricted to bright, moderately long, slender four-plane objects, so they cannot establish performance on faint, short, long, touching, or irregular cases. One generated tracking figure also has visibly clipped/overlapping footer text. These missing and unrepresentative visual controls block acceptance.

findings.title: Required stage-by-stage visual evidence is absent
findings.impact: Misses, merges, false splits, boundary leakage, centerline errors, and final-overlay discrepancies cannot be assessed at identical framing, so the production segmentation and measurement geometry are not visually validated.

findings.recommendation: Create commit-bound audit panels with identical crops showing raw image, foreground probability, core probability, thresholded filled mask, labeled instance boundaries, centerline, track identity, and final production overlay.

findings.title: Tracking examples are selection-biased and omit required cases
findings.impact: Three bright, slender, moderate-length four-plane tracks per specimen cannot support a claim of morphology-neutral performance or expose failures on faint, short, long, touching, and irregular nuclei.

findings.recommendation: Provide predeclared or stratified examples for faint, bright, curved, short, long, touching, and irregular objects, including accepted tracks, rejected joins, missed detections, merges, and splits.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as prohibited by the review request.
Inspection was limited to repository source, manifests, reports, and focused generated artifacts already present locally.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
The raw Leica source images referenced by the pilot manifest are external to the reviewed commit, so artifact-to-source identity was not independently established.
recommended_follow_up: Generate a fixed visual-audit bundle for both specimens with identical framing across every required processing stage.
Add stratified examples for all required intensity, shape, length, and touching-object categories, with explicit expected/adjudicated outcomes.
Include negative examples showing missed detections, merges, false splits, boundary leakage, and rejected tracking joins.
Regenerate tracking figures without obscuring markers or clipped captions.
Record hashes and provenance for all visual artifacts in the append-only audit run, then request a new independent visual_evidence review.
